node.title: H3 quotient-orbit three-resultant candidate screen
node.statement: For every canonical quotient-orbit block, the resultants of its orbit polynomial against the first three Hasse derivatives of the global shifted-product polynomial are not all zero. The exact cutoff-35 scalar annihilator divides their positive odd gcd. Thus every official (P,R)>=(36,1) prime is retained by a complete three-resultant-per-block candidate screen: 73,602 ordinary resultants at n=8192. Full factorization and exact evaluation can replace exact Smith elimination, but the screen may contain false positives and carries no runtime, cost, moment, or C36 bound.
